import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    result = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id"))

    order_items = db["order_items"]
    order_items = order_items[order_items["ts"] < seed_time].copy()

    valid_orders = order_items["order_id"].unique()

    # --- Агрегация по всей истории продаж (только до seed_time) ---
    product_sales = order_items.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_revenue=("price", "sum"),
        total_units=("order_id", "count"),
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
        n_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique"),
    )
    product_sales["has_sales_history"] = 1

    # --- Агрегация за последние 90 дней ---
    cutoff_90 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
    recent = order_items[order_items["ts"] >= cutoff_90]
    recent_sales = recent.groupby("product_id").agg(
        recent_revenue=("price", "sum"),
        recent_units=("order_id", "count"),
        recent_avg_price=("price", "mean"),
    )
    last_sale = order_items.groupby("product_id")["ts"].max()
    recent_sales["last_sale_days"] = (seed_time - last_sale).dt.days

    # --- Агрегация за последние 30 дней ---
    cutoff_30 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)
    r30 = order_items[order_items["ts"] >= cutoff_30]
    sales_30 = r30.groupby("product_id").agg(
        units_30d=("order_id", "count"),
        revenue_30d=("price", "sum"),
    )

    # --- Отзывы: только те, что уже созданы к моменту seed_time ---
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    reviews = reviews[
        reviews["order_id"].isin(valid_orders)
        & (reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time)
    ].copy()
    reviews_w_products = reviews.merge(
        order_items[["order_id", "product_id"]], on="order_id", how="left"
    )
    product_reviews = reviews_w_products.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_reviews=("review_id", "count"),
        avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
        pct_negative_reviews=("review_score", lambda x: (x <= 2).mean()),
    )

    # --- Объединение ---
    features = product_sales.join(recent_sales, how="outer")
    features = features.join(sales_30, how="outer")
    features = features.join(product_reviews, how="outer")

    # --- Обработка пропусков ---
    count_cols = [
        "total_units", "total_revenue", "total_reviews",
        "recent_units", "recent_revenue", "units_30d", "revenue_30d",
    ]
    for col in count_cols:
        if col in features.columns:
            features[col] = features[col].fillna(0)

    if "has_sales_history" in features.columns:
        features["has_sales_history"] = features["has_sales_history"].fillna(0)

    if "last_sale_days" in features.columns:
        features["last_sale_days"] = features["last_sale_days"].fillna(3650)

    avg_cols = [
        "avg_price", "avg_freight", "avg_review_score",
        "pct_negative_reviews", "recent_avg_price",
    ]
    for col in avg_cols:
        if col in features.columns:
            mean_val = features[col].mean()
            if pd.isna(mean_val):
                mean_val = 0
            features[col] = features[col].fillna(mean_val)

    if "n_sellers" in features.columns:
        features["n_sellers"] = features["n_sellers"].fillna(0)

    # --- Числовой тип ---
    for col in features.columns:
        if not np.issubdtype(features[col].dtype, np.number):
            features[col] = pd.to_numeric(features[col], errors="coerce").fillna(0)

    # --- Реиндексация под запрошенные товары ---
    result = result.join(features, how="left")
    result = result.fillna(0)

    for col in result.columns:
        result[col] = result[col].astype("float64")

    return result
